# MICA Digital

MICA Digital, also known as Made in Canada Digital, is an Indigenous-owned Canadian digital studio based in Barrhaven, Ottawa, Ontario. MICA designs and develops custom websites and digital experiences for small businesses in Ottawa and across Canada.

## Core services

- Custom web design: https://madeincanadadigital.ca/web-design.html
- Website redesign: https://madeincanadadigital.ca/website-redesign.html
- Accessible web design and UX/HCI: https://madeincanadadigital.ca/accessible-web-design.html
- Responsive web development and focused custom functionality: https://madeincanadadigital.ca/web-development.html

## Business information

- Service area: Ottawa, Barrhaven, Ontario, and remote projects across Canada
- Project inquiries: projects@madeincanadadigital.ca
- General contact: info@madeincanadadigital.ca
- Services: https://madeincanadadigital.ca/services.html
- About: https://madeincanadadigital.ca/about.html
- Contact: https://madeincanadadigital.ca/contact.html

MICA does not publish fake client work, reviews, ratings, awards, or fixed prices. Interface studies on the home page are original design explorations, not completed client projects.
